units: <cite ref="Pesachim 10a:2">Pes. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>צ׳ אחד של חמץ</he> one pile of leavened matter.—Pl. <he>צִיבּוּרִים</he>, <he>צִיבּוּרִין</he>, <cite ref="R00295"><he>צִבּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>עשה צ׳ וכ׳</he> he put up piles of sand and brought sieves &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 62:20">Yalk. ib. 62</cite>, end; Yalk. Neh. 1071, v. <cite ref="R00070"><he>צֶבֶר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:2">B. Mets. II, 2</cite> <he>צִבּוּרֵי פירות</he> fruit in piles; <he>צ׳ מעות</he> coins in piles.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 6:4:1">Y. Peah VI, 19ᶜ</cite> bot. (ref. to <he>ציבורי זיתים</he>, ib. VI, 5) <he>מה בין הצ׳ מה בין הזיתים</he> what difference is there whether there are piles of olives or olives (not piled up)?; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:5">Ber. V, 5</cite> <he>ואם שליח צ׳ הוא</he> and if it happened to him as a deputy of the congregation (public reader of prayers).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18a:10">R. Hash. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>גזר דין של צ׳</he> an evil decree concerning a community, opp. <cite ref="J00284"><he>יחיד</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 40a:13">Sot. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>אימת צ׳</he> the fear (respect) of the assembled congregation.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8a:1">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>בשעה שהצ׳ מתפללין</he> when the congregation is in prayer.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:3">Zeb. V, 3</cite> <he>חטאת הצ׳</he> communal sin-offerings; a. fr.
